regime.name: Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral)
regime.why: 11-16 h mean 10.0 kt from 316°; 07-10 h 12.2 kt from 250°

days.headline: Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral): 10 kt avg from NW (316°) 11-16 h, TRANSITION day. Favoured: right. Confidence low.
interpretation: Offshore northerly: gusty and shifty near shore, flatter water close in; expect the wind to ease or back late if the gradient weakens (watch AROME trend).
Land-sea contrast: inland max 22.9 °C vs sea 24.0 °C (ΔT -1.1 °C); morning offshore component 0.0 kt → sea-breeze potential none (land not warmer than sea).
Over the water: air -1.5 °C vs sea → near-neutral.
Front/instability warning: MSL pressure change 08→18 h 1.6 hPa, AROME gust factor 1.62.

History (Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral) (all speeds; fewer than 8 buoy days in the 10-15 kt band), 104 days, Oct-Mar since 2022-11): buoy averaged 11.86 kt (q25-q75 9.58-13.36, n=20) when AROME said 8.05 kt (median of all 104 days). LEPA airport averaged 11.05 kt (n=104). Direction 11→15 h at the buoy: veer 50% / back 33% / steady 17% (n=6).

strategy.text: AROME has the wind changing character during racing (direction change +62° 11→16 h, max hourly step 39°). Treat as a transition day: new wind arrives from one side, expect a postponement or a big one-way shift.
strategy.history_bias: History leans VEER: 50% of analog days veered >5° 11→15 h, 33% backed.
strategy.side_text: Favoured side: RIGHT. Offshore wind: puffs come off the Serra/Na Burgesa valleys in streaks; look upwind for dark patches, expect more pressure and bigger shifts nearer the shore. (inference)
strategy.start: Transition: delay committing. In the sequence watch the new wind's side (webcams/stations upwind); start at the end nearer it and keep clear air to tack.
strategy.windward_mark: Don't take a layline early; the mark can swing a long way. Stay between the fleet and the new wind.

why: AROME HD vs AROME France 11-16 h: mean |Δspeed| 1.3 kt, |Δdir| 4°

expected_observed.text: AROME 11-16 h mean 10.0 kt × historical ratio of buoy-observed to AROME-Portals (q25 1.21, median 1.32, q75 1.67, n=20 days). Hourly AROME range 8.4-11.8 kt. This is open-bay (SOCIB buoy) wind; inshore Portals usually reads lighter.

Gold Cup shroud extremes: max tight 20 V / 12 D, max loose 14-15 V / 7-8 D.

regime.name: Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral)
regime.why: 11-16 h mean 12.0 kt from 310°; 07-10 h 7.5 kt from 309°

days.headline: Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral): 12 kt avg from NW (310°) 11-16 h, oscillating. Favoured: right. Confidence high.
interpretation: Offshore northerly: gusty and shifty near shore, flatter water close in; expect the wind to ease or back late if the gradient weakens (watch AROME trend).
Land-sea contrast: inland max 20.9 °C vs sea 23.8 °C (ΔT -2.9 °C); morning offshore component 2.6 kt → sea-breeze potential none (land not warmer than sea).
Over the water: air -3.6 °C vs sea → unstable (air colder than sea). Expect puffs and lulls bigger than AROME gusts suggest.

History (Northerly (Tramuntana / Mestral) (all speeds; fewer than 8 buoy days in the 10-15 kt band), 104 days, Oct-Mar since 2022-11): buoy averaged 11.86 kt (q25-q75 9.58-13.36, n=20) when AROME said 8.05 kt (median of all 104 days). LEPA airport averaged 11.05 kt (n=104). Direction 11→15 h at the buoy: veer 50% / back 33% / steady 17% (n=6).

strategy.text: AROME is steady (≤15° over the race window). Climatology for this regime at the buoy: shift std 10.1°, peak-to-peak 22.6°, cycle ~58 min. Tack on headers vs the median heading.
strategy.history_bias: History leans VEER: 50% of analog days veered >5° 11→15 h, 33% backed.
strategy.side_text: Favoured side: RIGHT. Offshore wind: puffs come off the Serra/Na Burgesa valleys in streaks; look upwind for dark patches, expect more pressure and bigger shifts nearer the shore. (inference)
strategy.start: Check line bias with transits several times; in a persistent shift start at the end nearer the new wind, even if it is slightly unfavoured. In oscillations, start where you can tack onto the lifted tack freely.
strategy.windward_mark: Expected drift to the right (history lean, oscillating): approach on the tack that keeps you inside the shift, and tack short of the layline (it moves).
